source_text: Emersit enim, fratres dilectissimi, novum genus cladis; et, quasi parum persecutionis procella saevierit, accessit ad cumulum sub misericordiae titulo malum fallens et blanda pernicies. Contra Evangelii vigorem, contra Domini ac Dei legem temeritate quorumdam laxatur incautis communicatio, irrita et falsa pax, periculosa dantibus et nihil accipientibus profutura. Non quaerunt sanitatis patientiam, nec veram de satisfactione medicinam. Poenitentia de pectoribus excussa est, gravissimi extremique delicti memoria sublata est. Operiuntur morientium vulnera, et plaga lethalis altis et profundis visceribus infixa, dissimulato dolore, contegitur. A diaboli aris revertentes, ad sanctum Domini sordidis et infectis nidore manibus accedunt. Mortiferos idolorum cibos adhuc pene ructantes, exhalantibus etiam nunc scelus suum faucibus et contagia funesta redolentibus, Domini corpus invadunt, quando occurrat Scriptura divina, et clamet et dicat: Omnis mundus manducabit carnem, et anima quaecumque manducaverit ex carne sacrificii salutaris quod est Domini, et immunditia ipsius super ipsum est, peribit anima illa de populo suo. Apostolus item testetur et dicat: Non potestis calicem Domini bibere et calicem daemoniorum, non potestis mensae Domini communicare et mensae daemoniorum. Idem contumacibus et pervicacibus comminatur et denuntiat dicens: Quicumque ederit panem aut biberit calicem Domini indigne, reus erit corporis et sanguinis Domini.
pass_a_gloss: For a new kind of disaster has emerged, most beloved brothers; and, as if the storm of persecution had not raged enough, a deceiving evil and a flattering destruction has been added under the title of mercy. Against the vigor of the Gospel, against the law of the Lord and God, the communion of the incautious is relaxed by the rashness of certain ones, a vain and false peace, dangerous to those giving and not profitable to those receiving. They do not seek the patience of healing, nor the true medicine of satisfaction. Repentance has been shaken out of hearts, the memory of the most serious and extreme sin has been removed. The wounds of the dying are covered, and the lethal blow fixed in the deep and innermost organs, the pain is disguised, it is covered. Returning from the altars of the devil, they approach the holy altar of the Lord with dirty and infected hands. Still almost belching the deadly foods of idols, even now exhaling their crime with mouths and fatal contagions, they invade the body of the Lord, when the divine Scripture occurs and cries out and says: Every world will eat flesh, and any soul which has eaten from the flesh of the sacrifice of salvation which is of the Lord, and its own impurity is upon it, that soul will perish from its people. The Apostle also testifies and says: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons, you cannot communicate with the table of the Lord and the table of demons. The same threatens and announces to the obstinate and perverse, saying: Whoever eats bread or drinks the cup of the Lord unworthily, will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

choices.why: to convey the idea of an unprecedented calamity
to indicate the false pretense of mercy
to emphasize the deceptive nature of the evil
to highlight the risk to those who offer false peace
to emphasize the lack of benefit to those who receive false peace

pass_b_english: A new kind of disaster has arisen, my most beloved brothers, and as if the storm of persecution had not raged fiercely enough, a deceitful evil and a flattering ruin have been heaped upon us under the guise of mercy. In defiance of the Gospel's power and the law of the Lord and God, the communion of the unwary is loosened by the recklessness of certain men; it is a hollow and false peace, dangerous to those who give it and useless to those who receive it. They do not seek the patience that brings healing, nor the true medicine of satisfaction. Repentance has been shaken out of their hearts, and the memory of the gravest and most final sin has been erased. They bandage the wounds of the dying, concealing the lethal blow driven deep into the innermost organs, masking the pain and covering it over. Returning from the altars of the devil, they draw near to the Lord's holy altar with filthy, infected hands. Still all but belching the deadly food of idols, their very throats now exhaling their crime and reeking with fatal contagion, they invade the body of the Lord — just when divine Scripture confronts them and cries out: 'Everyone shall eat the flesh, and any person who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of salvation that belongs to the Lord, while his uncleanness remains on him, that person shall be cut off from his people' (Leviticus 7:20). The Apostle also testifies and says: 'You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons; you cannot partake of the table of the Lord and the table of demons' (1 Corinthians 10:21). He threatens and warns the obstinate and perverse with the same words: 'Whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord unworthily will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord' (1 Corinthians 11:27).

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Latin text. Pass B correctly identifies and provides the required inline citations for the Scripture passages (Leviticus 7:20, 1 Corinthians 10:21, and 1 Corinthians 11:27) which were present in the Latin text as allusions/quotes. Pass A is a faithful gloss. All clauses, agency, and nuances are preserved.
